notes_for_editor: Only the tnlandforms catalogue supports the record (county, elevation, standing). Two searches and the cached NHLR, FFLOS, OSM and GNIS pages found no Hyndsver tower or history. The 'standing' status is undated in the catalogue. The 9-1 code in the catalogue is unexplained. The story is short because the evidence is short. Next steps: Tennessee Division of Forestry records, Weakley County historians, or a local newspaper search.
